text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for service=redwood-runtime region=az5 — high 5xx rate and latency spike. threshold: 5xx > 8% for 2m. metric link: https://console.redwood/metrics/az5?metric=5xx_rate

pagerduty-bot: PD-72841 created and paged: paging oncall group `sre-oncall`. escalation policy: 10m -> sre-lead. Incident page: https://pd.redwood/INC72841

maria-ops: acked — I'm on it. seeing 12% 5xx and tail latency 2.1s. starting triage. any recent deploys?

raj-sre: no deploys in last 30m. looking at node telemetry — multiple NIC flaps on compute-pool-az5-*. kernel rx errors + BGP withdraws from fabric. starting node-level collection now.

devon-frontend: customer reports: large modal generation requests failing with immediate 502s, several complains in #support. sample request ids: r-3a7f, r-3a80, r-3a93.

incident-bot: autopager: activated fallback routing policy `regional-fallback-v2` for az5 after threshold. Traffic diverted ~40% to az3/az4. See routing console: https://console.redwood/routing/fallbacks/az5

maria-ops: confirmed traffic diversion. ingress volume decreased on az5 but error rate still elevated for remaining traffic. starting targeted failover for overloaded shards.

raj-sre: node logs: `eth0: link down` repeated on 5 nodes in the pool. NIC errors correlate with kvcache eviction spikes. running `ssh node && sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep err` on a few hosts.

raj-sre: command outputs (snippet):
```
$ sudo dmesg | tail -n 50
[...]
NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0 (nvnet): transmit queue 0 timed out
nvnet 0000:3b:00.0: NIC rx errors: 1234
```

maria-ops: moving affected shards to standby in az3/az4. toggling routing weight for model-serving routes. runbook used: https://confluence.redwood/runbook/az-network-degradation

emily-cs: pinging top 3 enterprise customers about degraded responses and mitigations. I'll post templates to thread.

devon-frontend: confirmed some sessions are resumed after diversion, but we have retries causing higher cost. watching for duplicated outputs.

raj-sre: initiated node-drain for nodes showing flaps: `infra drain-node --node compute-pool-az5-22 --grace 30s` — started on 4 hosts. kvcache eviction rate dropping from 18% -> 6% on those shards after move.

incident-bot: Pager update: PD-72841 status -> acknowledged by maria-ops. next escalation if not resolved: sre-lead in ~6m.

sre-lead: joining. good work. prioritize: 1) stabilize control plane to stop new connections failing, 2) ensure KV cache warmup on fallback nodes, 3) validate no data loss. Who's owning control plane?

maria-ops: taking control plane checks. running `controlplanectl health --region az5` and checking grpc/connect counts. so far control plane shows slow reconcile but healthy. I will bump replica target for control-plane to 3 temporarily.

raj-sre: hardware team notified — potential NIC firmware bug. raising ticket with datacenter ops and requesting spares.

devon-frontend: we should enable `request-idempotency` for heavy endpoints to reduce duplicate billing/dup responses. Can we toggle that quick?

maria-ops: yes toggled for `model-generate` routes to retries=1 and idempotency=true. monitoring.

emily-cs: customers notified with status page link; will update with ETA 30m for mitigation. using template: "we've diverted traffic and are performing node failovers; degraded responses expected to improve in 20-40m."

raj-sre: short-term summary: diversion active, 4 bad nodes drained, kv eviction rate falling, error rate in az5 partial traffic down from 12% -> 4% overall across region. still seeing intermittent spikes on leftover nodes. pending hardware replacement.

maria-ops: next steps: keep diversion active, finish replacing 2 more nodes, confirm KV warmup on fallback nodes, and reduce routing weight back when stable. I'll hand off after 45m to night oncall.

incident-bot: autopager note: fallback routing will auto-revert in 2h unless manually cleared. set a reminder if you want extended diversion.

devon-frontend: can someone post the command to clear fallback once we verify?

maria-ops: `routingctl disable-fallback --region az5 --policy regional-fallback-v2` — will run after signoff.

raj-sre: filing post-incident ticket with timeline and hardware vendor reference: TICKET-9012. attaching node logs and NIC stats.

sre-lead: tagging for follow-up: firmware upgrade across az5 fleet, improve NIC error alerting, and add runbook step for immediate routing weight reductions. good triage.

maria-ops: handing off to night oncall @sre-night. I've written a short runbook note in the incident page with actions taken and current state.

emily-cs: will keep customers updated. will escalate any high-severity requests to pagerduty.

incident-bot: PD-72841 -> status: monitoring. last metric snapshot: aggregated 5xx=3.9% (after diversion). closing the active page; keep thread open for updates.

maria-ops: moving to follow-up. thanks all :thumbsup:
